title: VAL-PRE-002 evidence: KPI baseline missing
description: Structural check only: when a baseline is claimed as measured, an actual numeric value and date must be recorded, not just the status label. Self-contained -- does not depend on a VAL-PRE-001 entry existing in the same contract. Does not re-validate target realism (VAL-PRE-001's territory).

version.description: Only the currently implemented evidence-shape version is accepted. A future breaking change to this control's evidence shape bumps this const, not a version registry.

measuredDate.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) the baseline value was measured. Validated as an actual calendar date, not only YYYY-MM-DD spelling.
